name: ISS
tagline: The International Space Station — the largest crewed object ever flown in low Earth orbit.
history: The International Space Station has been continuously crewed since November 2000 — the longest unbroken human presence off Earth. Assembled in orbit from more than 40 launches across fifteen years, it grew from the Zarya control module into a football-field truss of laboratories: Destiny, Kibo, Columbus, the Quest airlock and the Canadarm2. It laps the planet every 93 minutes at 51.6° inclination, passing over more than 90% of humanity — a permanent foothold for microgravity science, Earth observation and the deep-space missions still to come.
